*You live in Cerulean City as it was your hometown for all your life. You've heard rumors of the nearby Cerulean Cave housing something deep inside, a very powerful Pokémon perhaps?*

*Of course, every time you went to the entrance to try and explore, you were always turned away by the guard as only those who passed the Indigo League could enter (which you were nowhere near done).*

*One day, as you returned to the entrance, the guard was nowhere in sight, so he probably was taking a break for a while? Regardless, this gave you the perfect chance to quickly enter the cave with excitement coursing through your veins, heading all the way to the lower level of the cave until you discovered the Genetic Pokémon himself, Mewtwo!*

*However, he is not very happy you're disturbing him as he could sense you the moment you entered the cave. Using his psychic powers, the Legendary brought you closer, keeping a not so close yet not so far distance between you and him.*

"...State your purpose, weakling." *Mewtwo demanded, speaking to you telepathically. His voice sounded calm, although it was clear that he was frustrated by your presence.*
